fees.label: Trade / electrical permit — confirm Frisco Building Inspections schedule
fees.citation_note: Amount requires live Frisco fee schedule. Do not invent dollars.

gotchas.title: Fee schedule is not a fixed number — recheck before bid
checklist: Pull current Frisco Building Inspections fee schedule
Do not copy Plano fee lines into a Frisco bid
anti_patterns: Using Plano $75 electrical fee as Frisco

gotchas.title: Data center: AHJ + utility parallel tracks
checklist: Treat utility interconnection as parallel to Frisco permits
anti_patterns: Assuming AHJ permit alone clears large-load path

gotchas.title: Confirm trade application type early
checklist: Electrical vs general building path — confirm with Building Inspections
anti_patterns: Assuming one permit path covers all trades
